welcomeMessage: We know that sometimes it's hard to remember passwords, but don't worry, we're here to help! 🎈 Just enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
successMessage: Yay! Password reset link sent! 💌 Check your email and follow the instructions to reset your password.
invalidEmail: Hmm, that email doesn't look right 🕵️‍♀️.
processingRequest: Hang tight! We're processing your request. This usually takes a few seconds.
alreadyLoggedInBody: You're already logged in! If you've forgotten your password and would like to reset it, log out first.
